shots.primerisimo primer plano: The opening frame is filled by the subject's face, from forehead to chin.
shots.primer plano: The opening frame shows the subject's head and shoulders.
shots.plano medio corto: The opening frame shows the subject from the chest up.
shots.plano medio: The opening frame shows the subject from the waist up.
shots.plano americano: The opening frame shows the subject from the knees up.
shots.plano general: The opening frame shows the subject's whole body from head to feet, with space around it.
shots.gran plano general: The opening frame shows the subject small within the whole environment.

angles.frontal: The subject's face and shoulders are square to the lens, with both eyes equally visible.
angles.perfil: Only one side of the subject's face is visible, the nose and chin in clean silhouette.
angles.contrapicado: The subject appears taller, seen from below.
angles.picado: The subject appears smaller, seen from above, with the floor around them visible.
angles.cenital: The top of the subject's head and shoulders face the lens from directly above.
angles.tres cuartos: The subject's face is turned partly away from the lens, with the far eye still visible.
angles.sobre el hombro: The back of the subject's shoulder fills one side of the foreground.

movements.fijo: The framing stays the same from the first frame to the last.
movements.acercarse: The subject grows steadily larger in the frame as the camera travels closer.
movements.alejarse: More of the surroundings come into view as the camera travels away.
movements.zoom in: The subject grows larger in the frame while the camera position stays the same.
movements.zoom out: More of the surroundings come into view while the camera position stays the same.
movements.panoramica izquierda: The view sweeps to the left across the space while the camera stays in place.
movements.panoramica derecha: The view sweeps to the right across the space while the camera stays in place.
movements.inclinar arriba: The view tilts upward while the camera stays in place.
movements.inclinar abajo: The view tilts downward while the camera stays in place.
movements.lateral izquierda: The camera glides to the left and the background slides past behind the subject.
movements.lateral derecha: The camera glides to the right and the background slides past behind the subject.
movements.grua arriba: The viewpoint rises vertically and reveals more of the space from above.
movements.grua abajo: The viewpoint lowers vertically toward the ground.
movements.seguimiento: The subject keeps the same size in the frame while the background moves past.
movements.punto de vista: The frame shows what the subject sees, from the height of their eyes.
movements.giro de horizonte: The horizon line rotates within the frame.
movements.giro antihorario: The horizon line rotates within the frame.

depth.profunda: The subject and the background are both in sharp focus.
depth.reducida: The background is softly out of focus behind the subject.
depth.muy reducida: The background melts into a smooth blur while the subject's eyes stay sharp.
